name: Have you created a report that highlights any security risks associated with using third-party products, including recommendations on how to manage those risks?
conditionsText:
Applies whenever:
- Third-party products are used.
- Security risks are identified.
- Procurement decisions are being made.
requirementTitle: Have you created a report that highlights any security risks associated with using third-party products, including recommendations on how to manage those risks?
requirementDescription: Have you formally documented the risks introduced by third-party products and explained how those risks will be managed?
why:
Decision makers need visibility of supplier risks before approving technology choices.
The report provides evidence that due diligence has been completed and allows risk owners to make informed decisions
